title: Allowlisting read-only POST endpoints for impersonation sessions
answers: Why does workflow audience count fail to load during read-only impersonation?
How to allow read-only POST endpoints during impersonation sessions?
Why is POST user_blast_radius blocked for impersonated users?
body:
Symptom: In workflow builder during read-only impersonation, audience size count fails to load with 403 impersonation_read_only.
Root cause: posthog/middleware.py:ImpersonationReadOnlyMiddleware blocks all non-idempotent HTTP methods before reaching viewsets, even for read-only actions that require POST for large payloads.
Fix pattern: Add an exact action path regex matching ^/api/(environments|projects)/([0-9]+|@current)/<prefix>/<action>/?$ to posthog/middleware.py:READ_ONLY_IMPERSONATION_ALLOWLISTED_PATHS.
Constraints: Applies only to read-only POST endpoints that perform no state mutations; never allowlist an entire prefix because mutating sibling actions share the prefix.
applies: Read-only POST endpoints blocked during impersonation in PostHog API
